objective: To upload Part List data from the Crossdock Master Setting - Part List screen into MASTER_CANDIDATE_PART.
To validate the complete workbook and save all valid changes as one transaction (Proposed); when a file or row error occurs, no master data is saved.

operation_flow.caption: Part List Upload - operation overview
operation_flow.note: Upload validation and transaction behavior are proposed because FSD OP-02 leaves them open.

constraints: The ongoing calculation period is used for Part List records.
MASTER_CANDIDATE_PART and TB_M_PART_MASTER are named in the existing draft; upload log and temp table names are proposed.
All-or-nothing saving, report sheet names, concurrent-run behavior and temp-row retention are proposed or TBD.
Changed-field history is outside this batch draft; confirm event coverage and retention with FSD OP-03.

steps.text: Retrieve UPLOAD_ID and the upload record from TB_R_CD_UPLOAD_LOG.
children: If the record or stored file is missing, log message no. 4 and stop.

steps.text: Set STATUS = 'PROCESSING' and START_DT, then check the workbook extension, size, row count, Upload sheet and headers (see 4.1).
children: If invalid, log message no. 5, set STATUS = REJECTED and proceed to step 6.

steps.text: Load every data row into TB_T_CD_UPLOAD_PART as text with UPLOAD_ID and Excel row number.
Validate all rows and store every validation error in the temp table (see 4.2). If any row fails, log message no. 6, set STATUS = REJECTED and do not write master data.
If all rows are valid, insert Add rows and update Edit rows in one transaction. Skip unchanged Edit rows. If a database error occurs, roll back, log message no. 8 and set STATUS = REJECTED.
Create the proposed result workbook; update status, counts, result path and END_DT in TB_R_CD_UPLOAD_LOG. Log message no. 9 if report creation fails; write batch end message no. 2 and return status.

func_desc.text: This batch processes one Part List workbook. The screen stores the file and creates an upload record with STATUS = RECEIVED before invoking the batch with UPLOAD_ID.

items: FSD section 9 defines the six template columns, .xlsx format, maximum 5 MB and maximum 5,000 rows.
The Upload sheet name, strict header-order check, all-or-nothing saving and result report are proposed because FSD OP-02 leaves upload processing open.
Only the ongoing calculation period is written. Parts not present in the workbook are unchanged.
Extension is .xlsx and file size is 5 MB or less (FSD).
Workbook contains 1 to 5,000 data rows (FSD); empty-file behavior is TBD.
The Upload sheet exists (Proposed); other sheets are ignored.
The six FSD headers exist in the order shown in Appendix. Strict order and extra-column handling are proposed.

func_desc.text: Validate every row and collect all errors so the user can correct the file once. Upload-specific checks not defined by the FSD are proposed.

rows: Value must be A or E.
Part No exists in TB_M_PART_MASTER. Add must not exist in MASTER_CANDIDATE_PART for the ongoing period; Edit must exist.
A Part No may appear only once in the workbook.
Required whole numbers greater than zero.
Required by the upload modal; numeric range and upper bound are TBD.
Required for Add per the upload modal. Edit can change it only while Candidate; a new date must be today or later (proposed); blank means keep current.
Whether a new value may be below the sum of existing destination mappings is TBD.

items: Flag A inserts a row with PART_STATUS = Candidate and SYNC_STATUS = 0 (BR-02); PART_NAME is looked up in TB_M_PART_MASTER.
Flag E updates the existing row. PART_NO, PERIOD, PART_NAME, PART_STATUS and created audit fields are not changed. TOTAL_PCS_DAY is recalculated.
If an Edit row has no changed business value, skip it and leave sync and audit fields unchanged.
For changed rows, set SYNC_STATUS = 0, LAST_SOURCE = UPLOAD, LAST_UPLOAD_ID = UPLOAD_ID, CHANGED_BY to the login user and CHANGED_DT to server time.
Commit all changed rows together (Proposed). On database error, roll back the complete upload and reject the run.
The existing draft proposes Summary, Result, Re-upload and Changes report sheets; confirm their exact columns, file path and retention.
Confirm temp-row cleanup, concurrent-upload handling, numeric limits, effective-date rules and the Max Case/Day versus existing mapping rule.
Per-field history is not included; confirm event coverage and retention under FSD OP-03.

action.system: Set status to REJECTED and create the proposed result report.
action.user: Download the template again, correct the file and upload it.

action.system: Reject the whole file; do not write master data.
action.user: Correct the Re-upload sheet in the result report and upload again.

logging_messages.message: Row <ROW_NO>, Part No <PART_NO> has no change and was skipped.

action.system: Do not update the master row.

logging_messages.message: Result report for <UPLOAD_ID> could not be created.

action.system: Leave RESULT_FILE_PATH blank and finalize the upload log.

logging_messages.message: Unexpected error in Part List upload: <ERROR_DETAIL>.

action.system: Roll back, set status to REJECTED and inform the system owner.
